answer: Influence is prepaid, per head. Each identity claims vote weight on the ocean roll at 15 POA per point into the burn fund, two points minimum, soulbound to one key, unshareable. Each epoch the holder signs a fresh link onto its thread, and lottery-drawn raven auditors replay one thread in nine, re-deriving its claimed weight. Any unbacked point burns the whole backing: 30 POA minimum gone, key benched two epochs. Fakes cannot pool: N fakes × 30 POA = 30N POA burned. Limits: honest newcomers post the same 30 POA.
